result: For the 9x9 PPT crosshatch tensor Q tensor Q defined below, EVERY coordinate projection retaining any four of nine basis states on Alice produces a 4x9 PPT state with SN<=2; the same holds independently for all 126 Bob coordinate projections, producing 9x4 states. Every nonzero output of a further local map on either side, including an arbitrary complex 9->4 map on the opposite side, has SN<=2. Thus no 4x4 SN>=3 candidate can be obtained from this source if either one local filter is a coordinate four-state projection followed by any output map, regardless of the opposite local filter. This strictly strengthens the earlier 15876 simultaneous-coordinate-cut theorem. It does not settle genuinely non-coordinate filters on both sides or arbitrary 4x4 PPT states.
source: Let Q=[|10>+|02>]+[|20>+|12>]+[|00>+|21>]+[|01>+|22>] from https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 Figure 1. Its trace is8 and its partial transpose is the sum of four two-term projectors, checked entrywise. Reorder Q tensor Q across Alice=(A1,A2), Bob=(B1,B2); the source is PPT, trace64. Q is entangled PPT of rank4, and Chen–Yang–Tang https://arxiv.org/html/1609.05100v1 Lemma 19(iii) gives SN(Q tensor Q)=4; this source SN4 step is an explicit published import documented in frontier-20261028-crosshatch-sn4-coordinate-drop-v1.json SHA256 66821aab1e903d1b073ff09a5434366cd2e1d00dd4120c684dd6695d3cc7d8bf. The output SN<=2 proof below does not depend on that import.
finite_census: For each side there are 126 four-element coordinate subsets. Nine are Cartesian products S1 x S2 with |S1|=|S2|=2; their one-side outputs are separable by tensoring explicit one-copy 2x3/3x2 product decompositions. The remaining 117 subsets per side have pinned exact phase certificates. Across these 234 nonfactorized subsets, the certificate table gives 496 disjoint source-ket phase groups, each involving at most four of the sixteen tensor-source kets. The group counts across the 234 subsets are: 18 with zero groups, 32 with one, 88 with two, and 96 with three.
positive_decomposition: Each tensor source ket is a four-entry partial-permutation matrix with supports disjoint from the other fifteen source kets; coordinate projection preserves both properties, so its rank is its number of surviving entries. In a certified group choose its recorded anchor and at most three further source kets with signs +/-1 and pairwise distinct exponents 1..6; define q_z=q_anchor+sum_j sign_j*z^(e_j)q_j for z^7=1. The verifier checks every 3x3 minor of q_z vanishes exactly as a polynomial modulo z^7-1, so q_z has SR<=2. Phase orthogonality gives the nonnegative average (1/7)sum_z[q_z]=[q_anchor]+sum_j[q_j]. The groups are disjoint in source-ket budget and cover every generator of rank>=3; all remaining generators individually have rank<=2. Consequently the exact one-side output is a positive SR2 sum. Tensoring an arbitrary local map on the opposite side, or applying any local output filter, preserves Schmidt rank and positivity of every term.
factorized_subsets: For each Cartesian subset S1 x S2, the coordinate projection is the tensor product of two one-copy coordinate rank-two filters. The six explicit product-projector decompositions of the resulting one-copy Q cuts are replayed from frontier-20261028-crosshatch-one-copy-product-check.py SHA256 c9e90c727a3c74841035e51d3a6fe54c297e0921256b0a1e5ee651f6431b37a5. Their tensor product is separable across the regrouped parties. This finite source-specific part uses no 2x3 separability import.

artifacts.observed: The independently written integer verifier reconstructs all252 one-side cuts and both orientations, verifies all81 source PT entries, checks partial-permutation ranks and disjoint source budgets, exactly covers all high-rank kets in the 234 nonfactorized records, checks 166656 cyclic 3x3 minor polynomials (1166592 integer coefficients), and hash-pins/replays all six exact one-copy product identities for the 18 factorized cuts. It uses no floating arithmetic or search code. Candidate groups were initially found with a numerical rank prefilter, but only this exact replay and the written root-of-unity identity are evidence.

limits: Only the original equal-weight Q tensor Q source and one-side coordinate projections (plus arbitrary subsequent local maps), not non-coordinate maps on both sides, a universal 4x4 PPT theorem, or an SN>=3 witness. The tensor SN4 label is explicitly imported; independent human/cross-vendor review and novelty remain open.
